name: Jared Palmer
doc_currency: First-party doc https://jaredpalmer.com/blog/formik-taming-forms-in-react (Sept 22, 2018) is still live and still listed as the top conference-talk resource on the official Formik docs site (formik.org/docs/resources), linking to the blog post. Historical (2018) but remains referenced as a current resource on official product docs.
dead_ends_searched: SearXNG search '"The Palmer Group" Jared Palmer design studio New York freelance' returned 0 results; corroboration for the design studio found via alternate queries (LeadDev, Brand Innovators, gitnation bios).

No standalone pre-Formik design portfolio found beyond the Palmer Group studio description and Dribbble presence; designer credentials rest on the studio he ran (self-disclosed on GitHub/site, corroborated by conference bios) plus the design (🎨) credit in Formik's all-contributors list.
